# Paths the Renovate agent may never call "safe": one extended regex per line, matched
# against every file a PR touches. A hit forces the verdict to needs-human in publish.sh,
# whatever the model said. These are the components whose breakage takes out the cluster,
# the data, or the runner the agent itself runs on (so it could not revert).

# OS, Kubernetes, infrastructure-as-code, CI
^talos/
^terraform/
^ansible/
^packer/
^k3s-bootstrap/
^\.github/
^flake\.(nix|lock)$
^renovate\.json$

# Networking, DNS, ingress
^k3s-apps/(cilium|coredns|metallb|traefik|traefik-external|stunner)\.yaml$
^k3s-userapps/externaldns/

# Storage and databases
^k3s-apps/rook-
^k3s-apps/csi-snapshot-controller\.yaml$
^k3s-apps/cnpg-
^k3s-apps/velero\.yaml$
^k3s-apps/harbor
^k3s-userapps/(csi-rclone|csi-addons|backups)/

# GitOps, secrets, policy, certificates
^k3s-apps/(argocd|metaapp|userapps|k3s-objects)\.yaml$
^k3s-apps/(openbao|eso|kyverno|cert-mgr)\.yaml$
^k3s-objects/
^k3s-userapps/(openbao|openbao-backup|cert-approver|zitadel)/

# The agent's own runner, node upgrades, VMs
^k3s-userapps/(github-runner|system-upgrade|kubevirt|kubevirt-vms)/
^k3s-apps/tuppr\.yaml$
